youtube_description:
The Go-Pod Micro Tourer Caravan is perfect for off-grid camping - for the times when you want to truly experience the great outdoors, and relax in solitude.

Watch the video for a breakdown of how the Go-Pod and accessories can be used for a truly off-grid holiday.
